objective: Implement the finite atomic stock-session timeout, canonical product-media identity, physical Library storage metrics, optimized-image metadata parity, dashboard stock-alert pagination/reset behavior, and positive Credit dashboard UI on the pinned integration base.
acceptance_criteria: Atomic create-products inventory sessions use a focused 60000 ms client timeout and retain the same client_request_id across retries; unsafe legacy per-line Fast Stock-In requests are unchanged.
Product upload, camera, file, and Library attachment flows persist canonical same-origin /uploads identity while cache busting remains render-only and failure messages remain accurate.
Library exposes physical stored bytes and file counts by type without double-counting logical product references, and image optimization synchronizes file_assets byte_size and MIME metadata.

Dashboard-only authorized users can page family-aware low/out stock alerts with stable order; the UI appends near the list bottom and resets rows, cursors, loading state, and inner scroll position when Dashboard becomes inactive.
Dashboard renders Credit as a positive metric using already-computed API fields without changing sales/accounting arithmetic.
Operator-facing batch received-date edits parse ambiguous slash dates explicitly day-first and preserve the derived batch code lineage.
Focused tests and both affected package typechecks pass.
